refund-window.question: How long do I have to send something back?
refund-window.answer: You can request a full refund within 60 days of purchase.

refund-timing.question: When does the money actually land back on my card?
refund-timing.answer: Refunds reach the original payment method within 5 business days.

cancellation.question: Can I cancel halfway through the month?
cancellation.answer: Yes. Cancel from Settings > Billing and it applies at the end of the period.

seat-removal.question: How do I take a seat off our plan?
seat-removal.answer: Seat changes are handled by our billing team, please open a ticket.
